heading.en: Why does a new auto-rickshaw lose value?

hook.en: An auto-rickshaw bought for ₹3 lakh earns fares for years, but every kilometre wears it out. Accounting spreads that cost over the years it earns: that is depreciation.
hook.kn: ₹3 ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಖರೀದಿಸಿದ ಆಟೋರಿಕ್ಷಾ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಿಲೋಮೀಟರ್ ಅದನ್ನು ಸವೆಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಆದಾಯ ತರುವ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಂಚುವುದೇ ಸವಕಳಿ.

objectives.en: Identify the factors used to measure depreciation.

narration.en: An auto-rickshaw bought for ₹3 lakh earns fares for years, but every kilometre wears it out. Accounting spreads that cost over the years it earns: that is depreciation.
narration.kn: ₹3 ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಖರೀದಿಸಿದ ಆಟೋರಿಕ್ಷಾ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಿಲೋಮೀಟರ್ ಅದನ್ನು ಸವೆಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಆದಾಯ ತರುವ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಂಚುವುದೇ ಸವಕಳಿ.

body.en: Depreciation is the decline in the value of a fixed asset due to use, passage of time or obsolescence. It is a process of allocating the cost of the asset over its useful life. It is a non-cash expense: it reduces profit but no cash is paid. Depletion is used for wasting assets such as mines; amortisation is used for intangible assets such as patents.

narration.kn: ಸವಕಳಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಬಳಕೆ, ಕಾಲದ ಕಳೆಯುವಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹಳತಾಗುವಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಆಸ್ತಿಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಾಗುವ ಇಳಿಕೆ. ಇದು ನಗದು ರಹಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚ. ಗಣಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಡಿಪ್ಲೀಷನ್, ಅಮೂರ್ತ ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಮಾರ್ಟೈಸೇಶನ್ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: On the board: What depreciation is

say.en: Depreciation is the fall in value of a fixed asset. Four things cause it.
Its amount depends on three factors: cost, useful life and residual value.
Sri Durga Mills: installation is part of cost, so the machine costs 2 lakh.
Scrap value of 20 thousand will come back. Only 1.8 lakh must be spread over the life.
Depreciation spreads this cost over the years of use. It is a non-cash expense.

body.en: Causes: wear and tear due to use, expiry of legal rights (a lease or patent), obsolescence, and abnormal factors such as accidents. We charge depreciation to match costs with revenue, to show true profit and a true and fair financial position, and to retain funds for replacement. Its amount depends on cost, estimated useful life and estimated net residual value.

points.en: Wear and tear, expiry, obsolescence, accidents
Matching, true profit, true position, replacement

narration.kn: ಸವಕಳಿಯ ಕಾರಣಗಳು: ಬಳಕೆಯ ಸವೆತ, ಕಾನೂನು ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಅವಧಿ ಮುಗಿಯುವುದು, ಹಳತಾಗುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಘಾತಗಳು. ಸವಕಳಿಯ ಮೊತ್ತ ವೆಚ್ಚ, ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಜೀವಿತಾವಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಉಳಿಕೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆ.

blocks.formula: \text{Depreciable cost} = \text{Cost of asset} - \text{Estimated net residual value}

caption.en: Depreciable cost = (purchase price + installation and other costs to bring it into use) − estimated net residual value.

narration.en: Change the cost, installation, scrap value and life and read the amounts.

tryThis.en: Default values: Sri Durga Mills. Check the depreciable cost is ₹1,80,000.
Raise the scrap value. Why does the yearly charge fall?
Double the useful life. What happens to the yearly charge?

problem.en: Sri Durga Mills buys a machine for ₹1,80,000 and pays ₹20,000 to install it. It expects to sell it as scrap for ₹20,000 at the end of its life. Find the depreciable cost.

steps.en: Cost of the asset includes installation: 1,80,000 + 20,000 = ₹2,00,000.
